info.name: carbium services
info.description:
Every JSON-RPC method served over HTTPS at services.carbium.sh (the WebSocket subscriptions are in openrpc.json), the old REST quote route, and every account API call on carbium.sh.

Keys: put serviceKey (a c_serv_ key) and accountKey (a c_acct_ key) in a Postman environment as current values, or in the Postman Vault, so a key never leaves with an exported or shared collection.

Do not run the whole collection: the folder "Changes the account" creates, changes and removes keys and webhooks, and some JSON-RPC calls cost many credits. Send those one at a time.

item.name: REST
item.description: One request per REST route. These routes have no schema in openrpc.json, which describes JSON-RPC only.

request.description: Request: none. Answers: your service keys, oldest first, revoked ones included: key_id, prefix, name, tier, scope, status, per_method_caps, max_connections, max_inflight, ip_allow, created_at, rotated_at, revoked_at. Never a key's value.
Request: none. Answers: your webhooks, without their address lists.
Request: none. Answers: the webhook with its addresses.
Request: none; ?limit=, ?before=. Answers: its delivery log, newest first.

Request: none; ?from= and ?to= as YYYY-MM-DD, given together, both days included (the last 7 days when left out; over 90 days is 400), ?key_id=, ?group=key. Answers: [{utc_day, method, method_class, call_count, credits_charged}], oldest day first; with group=key each row also carries its key_id (null for calls made before a key was rotated, or by a key since deleted). A key_id that is not yours is 404, and an answer of more than 50,000 rows is 400: narrow the range or name a key. Answers are kept 15 s.

Request: none. Answers: {period_start, period_end, account_credits, keys: [{key_id, credits, calls}]}: this calendar month (UTC) per service key, revoked ones included. Calls made before a key was rotated, or by a key since deleted, count in account_credits only; account_credits is null when the read failed.
Request: none. Answers: [{key_id, rps_current, class_rps}]: calls a second over the last 20 s for each live key, in all and per method class.

Request: none; ?from= and ?to= as RFC 3339 times, given together (the last 24 hours when left out; over 7 days is 400), ?key_id=. Answers: [{hour, key_id, method_class, calls, credits_charged, errors, resp_bytes}], kept 90 days; the newest hour can be two hours behind. Answers are kept 60 s.
Request: none; the same ?from=, ?to= and ?key_id=. Answers: [{hour, key_id, method_class, calls, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms}]: milliseconds with up to 3 decimals, kept 90 days. Answers are kept 60 s.
Request: none. Answers: {account_id, email, wallet, status, created_at, tier, term, payments}: the plan and its term, and the last 24 payments.
Request: none. Answers: {granted, used, remaining}, in credits.
Request: none. Answers: [{period_start, period_end, granted, used, current}]: credits per month, the running month first.
Request: none. Answers: your payments, newest first, 1,000 at most: id, amount_minor, currency, status, method, tier or module and plan, months, credits_granted, reference, paid_at.
Request: none. Answers: every module with its plans and what the account holds of it.
Request: none. Answers: one on-chain payment of yours and its status: open, paid, held or expired.
Request: none. Answers: the calling key's own record.
Request: none; ?limit= (50, at most 200), ?before= (a Unix-ms time). Answers: [{ts, action, request_id, detail}]: what the key changed, newest first; another key's id is 404.
Request: none. Answers: the live keys' records, newest first. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
Request: none. Answers: {challenge, difficulty}: a proof-of-work puzzle, asked for by a first sign-in.
Request: none. Answers: {version, url}: the terms a new account accepts; an empty version means none are asked.
Request: none. Answers: {plans, quote}: every plan and Quote plan with its price; with a session, what this account can buy.
Request: none. Answers: {confirm, blocked, keys, credits_remaining, terms}: what deleting the account would end. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
Request: none. Answers: {pdf, page}: the card provider's receipt links; an on-chain payment is 404. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.

item.name: Changes the account
item.description: Each call here creates, changes or removes something on the account: POST /v1/keys, for one, creates a live key. Send them one at a time, never as a folder run.

request.description: Request: {name, scope}, both optional: name up to 48 characters, scope a list of rpc, ws, grpc, quote and das (rpc, ws, grpc and das when left out; quote needs the Quote module). Answers: {key_id, prefix, raw_key, name}: the key's value, shown here once and mailed to the account's email address when it has one. 409 at your plan's count of service keys, or for quote without the module.
Request: none. Answers: {prefix, raw_key}: a new value for the same key, mailed like a new key's; the old one is refused at once.
Request: none. Answers: {applied}: true the first time, false on a repeat; every door refuses the key at once, and the first revoke mails a notice.
Request: none. Answers: {deleted}: the key is gone from the list, and a live one is refused at every door; a repeat is 404.
Request: {name}: up to 48 characters, "" clears it. Answers: {name}.
Request: {scope}: the whole new list of planes (rpc, ws, grpc, quote, das), at least one; a plane left out is removed. Answers: {key_id, scope}; the doors follow within a second.

Request: {per_method_caps}: the whole new list of {method_class, rps_ceiling (0 or left out: no ceiling), allow (true when left out)}; [] clears every cap. method_class is o1_cached, bounded_read, bounded_slot, write_send, compute, bounded_disk, range, scan, gpa or das (the 10 DAS methods together). Answers: the stored list; the doors follow at once.
Request: {ip_allow}: the whole new list of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and CIDRs, 16 at most; [] admits any address. Answers: {key_id, ip_allow}; a call from any other address is 403 at the door.

Request: {max_connections, max_inflight}: 0 to 10,000 each; 0 or left out is the plan's own number, and both are replaced together. Answers: {max_connections, max_inflight}; the WebSocket and stream doors follow within 5 minutes.
Request: the create fields. Answers: {webhook, secret}: the signing secret, shown here once.
Request: any create field, status. Answers: the webhook.
Request: none. Answers: {"deleted": true}.
Request: none. Answers: {secret, secret_hint, previous_valid_until}.
Request: none. Answers: how one signed test event went.
Request: {confirm}: exactly "DELETE". Answers: {deleted, keys_revoked, renewals_stopped}. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.

Request: {plan}, or {} for the cheapest: a plan with no price (a priced one is 400 "plan '<name>' must be purchased"). Answers: the module as the account now holds it; 409 "module not available yet", 429 past the change limit.
Request: none. Answers: the module as the account now holds it, removed. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.

Request: {name, access, expires_in_days, ip_allow}: name 1 to 48 characters and access "full" or "read", both required; expires_in_days 30, 90 or 365 (null or left out: no expiry); ip_allow up to 16 addresses or CIDRs (left out: any address). Answers: the new key's record with its raw_key, this once; 409 at 5 live keys, 403 while the account is not active. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
Request: none. Answers: {api_key_id, revoked}; a repeat answers the same. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.

Request: {step, wallet}: step "challenge" answers a message to sign; step "verify" takes nonce_token and signature (and pow on a first sign-in). Answers: {nonce_token, message} for "challenge"; {session_token, account} for "verify".
Request: {email}, and pow for an address with no account yet. Answers: {pin_token}: a six-digit code is mailed; the answer is the same for every address.
Request: {pin_token, code}. Answers: {session_token, account}.
Request: none. Answers: 204, no body: every session of the account ends. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.

Request: {step, wallet}: step "nonce" answers a message to sign; step "link" takes nonce_token and signature. Answers: {nonce_token, message} for "nonce"; the account with a new session_token for "link" (the old sessions end). Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
Request: none. Answers: {available, raw_key}: the key's value while the account still holds it, else available false. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.

Request: {tier} for a plan, or {module, plan} for a module plan; recurring for a card subscription. Answers: {url, session_id, amount_minor, currency, recurring, term}: the card checkout page to open. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.

Request: {tier} or {module, plan}; months, mint (USDC or USDT) and the paying wallet as payer. Answers: one on-chain payment to make: recipient, amount, reference, expiry, and a ready transaction when payer is given. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
Request: none; ?module=. Answers: {url}: the card provider's page for the subscription. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
Request: none; ?module=. Answers: {module, renews, ends_at}: the renewal is cancelled, the term runs to its end; 409 when there is none. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
Request: none; ?module=. Answers: {module, renews, ends_at}: the cancelled renewal is resumed; 409 when there is none. Needs a dashboard session: an account API key is refused.
